A.depoimento: I marched two archer squads from Lisboa to take the neutral villages of Santarem and Evora. With these victories my realm grows, and I now have the resources to build a stronger force for the next advance.
A.plano: Capture Santarem and Evora this turn to gain two new villages and their income. Next turn, use the combined wood and iron output of all three villages to train a mixed army of spears, archers, and knights. Then push outward along the road network toward Salamanca and Badajoz, securing choke points and expanding control until we hold at least 18 villages for two consecutive turns.

B.depoimento: I marched my forces to seize Tarragona and Girona, using archers to gain the combat edge. After hard fighting, both villages fell under my banner. I also trained a new archer in Barcelona for the future.
B.plano: Next turn reinforce Tarragona and Girona with fresh troops, continue building archers in Barcelona, and prepare to push toward Zaragoza and Valencia. Keep at least one defender in each village to avoid losing them. Do not split forces evenly; favor archer-heavy attacks for the counter bonus.

A.depoimento: Reinforced Santarem with a knight from Lisboa and started training spearmen in Lisboa to prepare for the assault on Coimbra.
A.plano: Use the knight sent to Santarem to capture Coimbra next turn. Then leverage Coimbra's wood and iron to train archers and knights for Badajoz and Faro. After securing those, push toward Salamanca and beyond to reach 18 villages for two consecutive turns.

B.depoimento: We marched 3 archers from Tarragona to take Castellon, and 3 spearmen with 3 knights from Girona to seize Zaragoza. Barcelona held its archer, building two more for future pushes. Our forces stand ready to expand further.
B.plano: Next turn reinforce Castellon and Zaragoza with fresh troops, continue building archers in Barcelona, and prepare to push toward Huesca and Valencia. Keep at least one defender in each village. Do not split forces evenly; favor archer-heavy attacks for the counter bonus.

A.depoimento: This turn I trained two spearmen in Lisboa and sent two archers from Santarem to seize Badajoz and two archers from Evora to seize Faro. My forces are now poised to strike Coimbra.
A.plano: Capture Badajoz and Faro with archers this turn, then use Lisboa's spearmen to take Coimbra next turn. After securing the three neutrals, build archers and knights in the new villages to push toward Salamanca and beyond, aiming to hold 18 villages for two consecutive turns.

B.depoimento: We sent archer detachments from Barcelona and Girona to bolster Zaragoza and Castellon, while launching a spear‑knight strike from Huesca toward Valencia. Barracks in Barcelona added new archers; Tarragona and Girona began spearman production. All villages retain a defending troop.
B.plano: Next turn: consolidate Zaragoza and Castellon garrisons, continue archer production in Barcelona, prepare Valencia assault with Huesca forces, and scout toward Teruel and Pamplona. Do not overextend; keep at least one defender per village. Avoid splitting forces; favor unit-type counters.

A.depoimento: This turn I sent Santarem's lone knight to seize Coimbra, while marching spears from Lisboa to bolster Santarem and Evora. I also ordered new spears in Lisboa and fresh archers plus spears in Santarem and Evora to prepare for the push into Salamanca and Sevilha. Our interior holdings stay safe as we prepare the next wave.
A.plano: Secure Coimbra this turn using Santarem's knight. Reinforce Santarem and Evora with spears from Lisboa while building spears in Lisboa and archers/spears in Santarem and Evora. Next turn, mass archers in Santarem/Evora to take Salamanca and Sevilha, then expand toward Madrid and beyond.

B.depoimento: I sent spearmen from Tarragona to strengthen Castellon, launched Zaragoza's archer toward Madrid and its knight toward Pamplona, and began archer production in Barcelona and Tarragona while Girona forged spearmen. Our forces are converging for a push toward Valencia.
B.plano: Next turn: attack Valencia from Castellon with spearman majority; continue archer production in Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona; hold Zaragoza with spearmen; prepare to assault Teruel from Castellon or Valencia; keep at least one defender per village; avoid overextending.

A.depoimento: Sent all available troops from Santarem, Evora and Lisboa to reinforce Coimbra, concentrating spears and archers there. Built spears in Lisboa and Santarem/Evora, and archers in Badajoz and Faro to prepare for future assaults. This strengthens our front while readying a push toward Porto and beyond.
A.plano: Build up a spear-heavy force in Coimbra using troops from Santarem, Evora and Lisboa. Next turn, continue reinforcing Coimbra while producing archers in Santarem/Evora for future use. Aim to capture Porto with spears once we have ≥6 spears, then use Porto as a base to take Salamanca with archers. Simultaneously, prepare Badajoz and Faro to seize Sevilha with archers.

B.depoimento: Turn 5: I launched an attack on Valencia from Castellon with 2 spearmen and 2 archers. I built additional spearmen in Girona and archers in Barcelona and Tarragona to strengthen future forces. All villages retain at least one defender.
B.plano: Next turn: assess Valencia attack outcome; continue building spearmen in Girona and archers in Barcelona/Tarragona; reinforce Castellon with spearmen if needed; prepare second wave to Valencia or Teruel; keep at least one defender per village.

A.depoimento: This turn I ordered each village to train two spearmen, sent reinforcements to Coimbra, and dispatched a mixed spear-archer force from Coimbra to capture Porto.
A.plano: Build spearmen in all villages to stockpile wood. Reinforce Coimbra with troops from Santarem, Evora and Lisboa. Launch an attack on Porto with a spear-heavy force from Coimbra. After securing Porto, use it as a base to take Salamanca with archers, then advance toward Toledo and Sevilha.

B.depoimento: I reinforced my villages with new troops and launched four attacks on nearby neutral villages. If successful, I will expand my control and move closer to the 18‑village goal.
B.plano: Build spearmen in Girona, archers in Barcelona/Tarragona, knights in Huesca, spears elsewhere. Send mixed forces to capture Teruel, Madrid, Murcia, Pamplona this turn. Keep at least one defender per home village.

A.depoimento: Built spearmen in all productive villages to stockpile. Sent archers from Coimbra and Badajoz to prepare an assault on Salamanca. Sent spearmen from Coimbra to Porto to mass for a strike on Vigo, and sent spearmen from Santarem to Badajoz to strengthen the Toledo front.
A.plano: Next turn, attack Salamanca with archers from Coimbra and Badajoz, and Vigo with spearmen from Porto reinforced by Coimbra. Following turns, take Toledo using built-up forces, then Sevilha, then push toward the enemy capital via Madrid and Zaragoza.

B.depoimento: This turn I dispatched archer squads from Barcelona and Tarragona to seize Teruel and Madrid, and sent knights from Huesca to take Pamplona. I reinforced my villages with new spearmen and archers, preparing for the next wave of conquest.
B.plano: Continue building spearmen for defense and archers for offense. Send remaining archers to capture Murcia next turn. Keep at least one defender per village. Avoid building knights due to iron shortage.

Statement:

I built spearmen in Valencia and Zaragoza to replace losses,
and added archers in Girona, Castellon, Barcelona, and Tarragona to strengthen my forces.
No enemy armies were sighted.
B.plano:
Plan:
Next turn, expect to capture Teruel and Madrid with archer waves reinforced by spearmen.
Build more archers in Girona and Castellon for future offense.
Keep at least one defender per village.

A.depoimento: Built elite knights and archers, sent forces to seize Salamanca and Sevilha, expanding our front.
A.plano: Capture Salamanca and Sevilha this turn, then build more archers and knights to take Vigo and Toledo next turn, advancing toward Madrid and the enemy capital.

B.depoimento:
This turn I sent archer waves from Barcelona and Tarragona to take Murcia and Toledo, and spearman columns from Girona and Teruel to seize Burgos and Salamanca.
I reinforced Barcelona, Girona, Huesca and Pamplona with new spearmen, archers and knights.
If successful, our holdings will grow to fourteen villages.
B.plano:
Next turn, secure the newly captured villages by leaving at least one defender each and begin building local garrisons.
Prioritize scouting the unexplored southwest (Lisbon area) while maintaining a defensive line along our current front.
Do not split forces; keep each village's army intact for rapid response.
Continue producing spearmen and archers for steady expansion.
